Container.Name: garmin-dashboard
Container.Overview: Private, self-hosted dashboard for your own Garmin data: steps, resting heart rate, sleep, HRV, Body Battery, stress and activities from Garmin's official Personal API, plus optional VO2 max, training status, readiness and recovery time. After the first start, open the WebUI: you'll create your login, then a short setup asks for your Garmin key. Race goals, units, time zone and the AI coach are in the dashboard's Settings.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the dashboard is served on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, secrets and Garmin sign-in token. Keep this private.

Config.Name: Allowed host names
Config.Description: Names (not IPs) you open the dashboard by, comma-separated, e.g. tower,tower.local. Opening by IP always works.

Config.Name: Sync interval (hours)
Config.Description: How often to pull new data from Garmin.

Config.Name: History on first sync (days)
Config.Description: How far back the first sync goes (official API).

Config.Name: Training history on first sync (days)
Config.Description: How far back the first Garmin Connect sync goes (VO2 max, training status, readiness).

Config.Name: Days re-checked each sync
Config.Description: Recent days re-pulled on every sync (sleep and HRV finalize late).

Config.Name: HTTPS reverse-proxy address
Config.Description: Only if behind an HTTPS reverse proxy: its exact public address, e.g. https://garmin.example.com

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Set true only behind an HTTPS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as (Unraid default: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (Unraid default: 100 = users).
